textTouch: Tap your player seal to clap.
notes: Touch and pad both answered now. `{clap}` resolves to a KEY, which is why the pad line could not just repeat the keyboard one; `{faceLeft}` becomes that controller's left face button — X on Xbox, Square on PlayStation, Y on Nintendo — which is where the clap is bound (CLAP_BUTTON, standard-gamepad index 2). The salute row in callouts.csv is the same line in the same shape. On touch there is no clap button at all: you tap the seal itself, see CONFIG.touch.clap. The words in all three cells are Ethan's; only the control is a token.
